result.summary: A residential one-way street with sidewalks but lacking marked pedestrian crossings or visible curb ramps at the intersection. Large trees and the one-way configuration may impact sight lines and vehicle speeds.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at the intersection, making pedestrian movements less predictable to drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Intersection area in the foreground and midground

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Large trees near the corner may partially obscure pedestrians waiting to cross from the view of oncoming drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the street near the corner

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian space and increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install tactile, sloped curb ramps at the corner to ensure accessibility for all users, including those with mobility aids.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Ensure the area near the intersection is clear of obstructions to improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is poor, featuring a very narrow sidewalk on one side and an open loading dock area on the other. The lack of marked crossings and the presence of large vehicles create significant safety risks and visual obstructions.

hazards.name: Narrow and obstructed sidewalk
hazards.description: The existing sidewalk is extremely narrow and potentially obstructed by utility poles or parked vehicles.

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from large vehicles
hazards.description: The large truck on the right obscures visibility for pedestrians and drivers near the loading dock.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Completion
interventions.description: Widen the existing sidewalk and extend it through the loading dock area with clear markings.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Crossing Markings
interventions.description: Install high-visibility crosswalks and signage to alert drivers to pedestrian presence.

result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection that is highly hostile to pedestrians, lacking basic infrastructure such as sidewalks and marked crosswalks. A large delivery truck parked at the corner creates a severe visual and physical obstruction, forcing any pedestrians directly into the path of vehicular traffic.

hazards.name: Major Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: A large delivery truck is parked immediately adjacent to the intersection, completely blocking sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Separation
hazards.description: The absence of sidewalks forces pedestrians to walk in the roadway alongside moving vehicles.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: The road surface is cracked and uneven, creating trip hazards and potential drainage issues.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct continuous, paved sidewalks on both sides of the street to provide a safe, separated space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Implement parking restrictions near the intersection to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks and ADA-compliant curb ramps to define safe crossing points.

result.summary: The image depicts a residential street with row houses and continuous sidewalks on both sides. Pedestrian safety is compromised by the lack of marked crosswalks and significant sightline obstructions caused by vehicles parked close to the intersection.

hazards.name: Unmarked Intersection
hazards.description: The absence of marked crosswalks at the corner fails to clearly communicate pedestrian priority to drivers.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstructions
hazards.description: Parked vehicles, including a large van and a tow truck, obscure the visibility of pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Curbside parking lanes near the corner

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install zebra-style markings to improve the visibility of the crossing area.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the intersection to ensure clear sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to reduce the crossing distance and place pedestrians in a more visible position before they enter the roadway.
